reuse.why: The link handler correctly goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount helper (with its already-linked guard), but the transaction download is a new copy of downloadAkahuTransactions instead of a shared provider downloader.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions repeats downloadAkahuTransactions line for line except for the URL and log text, and the new balance branch in processBankSyncDownload repeats the Akahu/Enable Banking reduce.

placement.why: Every piece sits where the other providers' equivalents live: server-config, types/models, accounts/app.ts linker and accounts/sync.ts download/dispatch.

scope.why: Focused on Fintegra; the client-side provider entries are small edits the request said were handled separately.

maintainability.why: Linking is shared, but each new JSON-provider adds another copied download function and balance branch to keep in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Linking uses linkBankSyncAccount; there is no shared downloader to bypass, only copies.

disguised_duplication.where: accounts/sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions is downloadAkahuTransactions renamed; the fintegra branch in processBankSyncDownload is the Akahu reduce reshaped (no local startingBalance, no rounding).
